Flow.description:
Screen subflow used to assign an asset from an Asset record. Captures assignment details and updates the Asset’s status, subscription, and current assignment. The Asset Assignment record is now created by the record-triggered flow Asset_After_Create_Assignment_on_Status_Change when Status and Status_Change_Notes__c change together.
2026-07-30: INC3-91 - Removed explicit Asset Assignment creation (legacy Update Status & Assigments subflow); Status_Change_Notes__c is now stamped on each asset in Stamp_Account so the record-triggered flow handles assignment creation and Current_Assignment__c stamping 2026-04-16: Remove refs to Additional Products | 2026-10-01 - Adam Pelc - Bundle Optionality (OPS-288/OPS-33/OPS-346): assetPicker no longer hard-required; added requireFullBundleFormula + Bundle_Completeness_Check decision to enforce full-bundle selection only for New Sale, with loop-back + on-screen warning on incomplete selection. | 2026-10-02 - Adam Pelc - Laptop-optional revision: assetPicker now receives optionalProductIds so only deal-type-dependent components (the laptop) vary by Type__c; everything else (incl. ICAM Scan Bodies Set) stays always-required regardless of deal type, same as today. Bundle_Completeness_Check simplified to just check selectionIsComplete - that per-group logic now lives entirely in the LWC. Part of Asset Assignments V2 / Bundle Optionality.
Flow.label: Asset Assignment Subflow - Screen - Set Assigned

recordUpdates.description: Bulk-updates Status and Status_Change_Notes__c (stamped on each asset in Stamp_Account) so Asset_After_Create_Assignment_on_Status_Change fires and creates the Asset_Assignment__c for serialized assets. Replaces the legacy Asset_Assignment_Subflow_Autolaunched_Update_Status_Assigments call as part of the INC3-91 migration.

fields.fieldText:
Provide Some Assignment Details


Confirm assignment details for the selected asset. This will mark the device as Assigned, update the asset to Assigned, and create an Asset Assignment record.


If this product is part of a bundle it will also assign related items (chargers, etc) to the account at the same time.
